misKeyed.names: the owner: the reader verified the named epoch's key against the group's commitment, and the wrap does not open under it
misKeyed.note: db/password version 2 with its wrap made under epoch 0's key while the record names epoch 1. The content id does not cover the wrap, so the record is listed and every check that needs no key passes. A reader opens a wrap only with the key of the epoch the record names.
misKeyed.underTheEarlierEpoch: opens, which a conforming reader never tries

note: Content keys, salts and IVs are fixed stand-ins for random draws: SHA-256("bsecret/vector/key/<name>/<version>"), the first four bytes of SHA-256("bsecret/vector/salt/<name>/<version>"), SHA-256("bsecret/vector/iv/self/<name>/<version>") and SHA-256("bsecret/vector/iv/epoch/<name>/<version>"). Payloads are padded to a multiple of 256 bytes. opens: the owner through the self wrap, and each member through the key of the epoch the record names, when it was a member of that epoch. bob was removed when epoch 1 began.
